headline: 38% MORE POWER. UNCONTESTED.
mechanism: FERC non-capacity license amendment, Bradley Lake / Dixon Diversion, Project No. P-8221-124

eval_history.fix: kicker collided with the headline; six flat horizontal bands; concrete out-brighted the focal; water read as dried mud
added piers, staining streaks and a flared chute for vertical rhythm; retyped the header to clear the collision
added form ties, recessed apron panels, gate stiffeners and turbulence, but the stone went too light and ate the focal contrast
darkened the stone and hoisted the lit gate leaf so the bay reads as open, but the shaft still read as a ramp
structural move: cropped in hard, 5 large bays instead of 7 small, and replaced the flat shaft with a ballistic falling nappe
stone shifted into the violet family, headline cleared off the ridge, spray rebuilt as soft droplets, crest walkway added
light now emerges from a shadowed head with jamb shading; chute walls cast onto the sheet; closed leaves deepened toward ink
shipped: nappe filaments and standing ridges, weathering variation across the apron, bounce light onto the flanking piers

eval_final.note: Nominal skill budget is 6 eval iterations. Iterations 7 and 8 were taken deliberately under the routine's exhaustiveness mandate ('8.5 is the FLOOR, not the target; keep iterating while iterations are clearly buying quality') because the score was still climbing (7.84 -> 8.125 -> 8.39 -> 8.585). One script crash occurred between iterations 7 and 8 (rectangle coordinate ordering in the jamb-shading loop); it was fixed and re-run and does not count as an eval iteration.
